diagnosis.overall_diagnosis: Q1 expected 11 entities (authors + key reviewers of CoachForce Market Research Report) but the agent returned only 8. The agent conflated 'key reviewers' with 'meeting participants' from the review meeting and missed authors/reviewers found in other evidence sources (e.g., PR reviewers, document author lists, chat-based review contributors). The skill's reviewer-extraction rules exist but were insufficient to force the agent to aggregate reviewers from ALL evidence types (document metadata authors, PR reviewers, meeting participants who gave substantive feedback, and chat-channel reviewers) rather than stopping at a single meeting's participants.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The 'key reviewer extraction rules' section did not prevent the undercounting failure. The agent limited Q1's 'authors and key reviewers' to the document author plus participants of one review meeting (8 total), missing 3 additional reviewers that appear in other artifacts (PRs reviewing the report, chat threads about the report, co-authors in document metadata, or additional meeting attendees). The skill needs clearer, enumerated aggregation procedure for 'authors and reviewers' questions: (1) always extract ALL authors/co-authors from document metadata fields (author, authors, co_authors, contributors), (2) collect reviewers from EVERY artifact type that references the target document — PRs (reviewers field), review meetings (participants + explicit reviewer mentions), chat channels/threads discussing the document (users who posted substantive review comments), and any 'reviewers' field in document metadata itself, (3) deduplicate by employee_id and return the UNION, (4) do not stop after finding one review meeting; search for ALL artifacts whose topic/title/body references the document title or codename. Also add a self-check: before finalizing, re-scan the full dataset for the document title AND its codename (e.g., CoachForce AND CoFoAIX) across chats/PRs/meetings and verify no reviewer-bearing artifact was skipped.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Add an explicit 'Authors + Reviewers Aggregation Protocol' subsection under the key reviewer rules. Specify: (a) Authors = union of document.author, document.authors, document.co_authors, document.contributors fields. (b) Reviewers = union across ALL artifacts referencing the target document (match by title AND any codename/alias): document.reviewers field, PR.reviewers for PRs linked to the document, meeting.participants for meetings whose title/agenda references the document (keeping only those with substantive transcript contributions), and chat message authors in threads/channels whose topic references the document who posted review-style feedback. (c) Mandate a two-pass search: first by official product name, second by codename/alias. (d) Require deduplication by employee_id and returning the UNION, not any single artifact's participant list. (e) Add a pre-finalization checklist: 'Did you search PRs? Did you search chat channels? Did you search by codename? Did you check document.co_authors and document.reviewers metadata fields?' Also clarify that 'key reviewers' is NOT equivalent to 'meeting participants' — it is the aggregated set across all review evidence.
